d:
Within the research facility, scientists are studying alien species with the ability to reproduce. While researching them, a single specimen breached containment and ambush one of the female scientist...

The parasite enters the scientist through her exposed mouth and begins corrupting her body. Once it is inside her, she can do nothing as her mind is slowly taken over by the parasite... After a while, she can no longer feel her body and the parasite begins controlling her. Using her possessed body to corrupt her fellow workers...
